ailang.legend: $A = pinned binary (v0.52.0, on main since PR #73) on every make line (AILANG=$A, AILANG_BIN=$A where Godot drives the sim); a fresh clone runs make runtime first. $PKG = fresh ailang-packages clone at origin/main (packages/celestial new, packages/relativity existing). $D = ../stapledons-design. GPU gates (make golden, make capture-m5, make bench SCENE=flyby) run on the Studio GPU window, not CI. All new M5 make targets live in mk/m5.mk (one include line in Makefile).

features.description: New package sunholo/celestial, part 1 (in $PKG/packages/celestial): ailang pkg init, manifest, [release] kind, README citing physics/planets-spec.md, AGENT.md; modules kepler (solveKepler fixed 8 Newton iterations from E0 = M + e sin M; stateFromElements perifocal -> ecliptic J2000 AU, AU/d), ephemeris (elementsAt: Standish Table 2a with b,c,s,f terms, secular rates frozen at the 3000 BC-3000 AD edge with a mean-orbit flag; satelliteAt: JPL SSD Laplace-plane mean elements with node/periapsis rates), frames (eclipticToGalactic: obliquity 84381.406 arcsec + Hipparcos 1997 matrix; poleAndSpin: IAU WGCCRE 2015). features.notes: Pins: relativity 0.5.2 -> 0.7.0 (carries M4.6a glowEmittanceAt), + celestial 0.1.0; lock relocked; runtime/cache refreshed (make runtime equivalent; gh download hung, staged from the same v0.52.0 tarball). Data: sol.ail (Standish T2a/2b; IAU 2015 poles/W/radii from NAIF pck00011 incl. periodic terms; DE440 GM; Mallama 2017 p_V; Binder 1973 k for Jupiter 1.0 / Saturn 0.825; JPL SSD satellite elements; NSSDC moon albedos; PDS (Saturn) + NSSDC ring bands), acen.ail (Akeson 2021 AB; Proxima c P/a cited to Kervella 2020; Chen & Kipping with its 1.008 normalisation; Proxima b,d confirmed per archive ps snapshot 2026-10-03 sha256-pinned; Proxima c and A b candidates; per-field measured|inferred|assumed; no B b). Tests: 22 checks (round-1 eval 89/100 follow-ups added Kepler's third law, NSSDC e and masses, p_V in (0,1], the Encke gap boundary, node signs, tighter moon-period tolerance) in celestial_test.ail (make sim test blocks + make strict-m5 strict VM == interpreter). Deviations: (1) design names 12 moons but says 11 - all 12 loaded; (2) design-repo ring table: only the Uranus row is wrong (rings 6..epsilon span 1.637-2.002 R, not 1.49-1.95); Saturn F (2.33) and Jupiter gossamer (3.10) are outside the table's scope, Neptune 1.69 is the Galle centre, Jupiter halo 1.25 is NSSDC vs Burns' ~1.29; checkRingPublishedEdges asserts the published edges positively and only the Uranus mismatch; (3) Uranus/Neptune Minnaert k: no citable visible value, Lambert assumed (cite key lambert-assumed); (4) GMs are DE440 for all bodies (agree with IAU 2015 nominal Sun/Earth/Jupiter to 1e-6); (5) Neptune Adams arcs not modelled (M5.2b). AILANG: strict VM refuses a long list literal of calls (register budget) - moons() split per system; reported to inbox user (inbox_1791037931866_b80f2b7c). Round-1 hygiene: 36 compile-cache files under sim/data/.ailang/cache untracked; .gitignore gains **/.ailang/cache/.
